title: A Locker for the Semester
author: E. M. Iversen
blurb: Lior Zhou, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
